# Encyclopedia.com

> > A comprehensive digital encyclopedia covering biographies, history, science, geography, and the arts with detailed entries on notable figures like Maria Montessori and Galileo, major world locations, and scientific concepts.

Encyclopedia.com provides authoritative reference content drawn from Oxford University Press and other scholarly sources, offering in-depth articles spanning education, medicine, astronomy, chemistry, architecture, and world history. The site serves as a research tool for students, educators, and general readers seeking reliable information across diverse academic disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Maria Montessori
- Galileo Galilei
- Early childhood education
- Montessori method
- Educational reform
- Abu Dhabi and UAE
- Ancient Egypt and Abydos
- Modern architecture
- Astronomy and constellations
- Oxford University Press
- Biography and historical figures
- Medical and anatomical sciences
- Chemistry and organic compounds
- Arabian Peninsula geography
- Women physicians and educators

## Notable Biographies

- [Galileo](https://www.encyclopedia.com/people/science-and-technology/astronomy-biographies/galileo): Biography of Galileo Galilei, astronomer and physics pioneer
- [Maria Montessori](https://www.encyclopedia.com/people/social-sciences-and-law/education-biographies/maria-montessori): Biography of Maria Montessori, pioneer in early childhood education
- [Ibn Tumart](https://www.encyclopedia.com/people/philosophy-and-religion/islam-biographies/ibn-tumart): Biography of Ibn Tumart, Mahdi and founder of Almohad movement
- [Sheikh Muhammad Abdullah](https://www.encyclopedia.com/people/history/south-asian-history-biographies/sheikh-muhammad-abdullah): Biography of Sheikh Muhammad Abdullah, Kashmiri independence leader
- [James Harrington](https://www.encyclopedia.com/people/social-sciences-and-law/political-science-biographies/james-harrington): Biography of James Harrington, 17th-century political theorist
- [Sir Patrick Home Of Polwarth](https://www.encyclopedia.com/people/history/british-and-irish-history-biographies/sir-patrick-home-polwarth): Biography of Patrick Hume, 1st Earl of Marchmont, Scottish nobleman

## Science and Mathematics

- [Absolute Value](https://www.encyclopedia.com/science-and-technology/mathematics/mathematics/absolute-value): Mathematical definition and explanation of absolute value operation
- [Acetone](https://www.encyclopedia.com/science-and-technology/chemistry/organic-chemistry/acetone): Chemical properties and uses of acetone (dimethyl ketone)
- [Aberration](https://www.encyclopedia.com/science-and-technology/physics/physics/aberration): Optical and stellar aberration in physics and astronomy
- [Eridanus](https://www.encyclopedia.com/science-and-technology/astronomy-and-space-exploration/constellations/eridanus): Southern constellation Eridanus and its ancient river associations
- [Smelting](https://www.encyclopedia.com/earth-and-environment/minerals-mining-and-metallurgy/metallurgy-and-mining-terms-and-concepts/smelting): Metallurgical process of smelting and ore processing techniques

## World Geography and Places

- [Lund](https://www.encyclopedia.com/places/germany-scandinavia-and-central-europe/scandinavian-political-geography/lund): Swedish city of Lund, medieval ecclesiastical and university center
- [Aba](https://www.encyclopedia.com/places/africa/nigeria-political-geography/aba): Nigerian city of Aba and ABA acronym definitions
